title: Lifted computation before halting
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Turing machines over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $K$ on $x$. If the computation from $c$ has a present state at every time $s<t$, then running the clock machine from the lifted configuration of $c$ for $t$ steps gives the lifted configuration reached by $K$ from $c$ after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: For every $s<t$, the state after $s$ steps from $c$ is present
